subject: Nichole Mossalam State Representative Candidacy
overview: Danielle Balocca interviews candidate Nichole Mossalam about her run for State Representative representing Medford and Malden. Mossalam shares a personal health update, discusses her legislative priorities, and outlines upcoming campaign events.

items.title: Introduction and Favorite Local Restaurant
items.summary: Host Danielle Balocca introduces State Representative candidate Nichole Mossalam, who shares her favorite local breakfast spot, Classic Cafe.

items.title: Candidate Background and Health Update
items.summary: Mossalam reflects on her previous legislative campaigns and details her recent diagnosis and treatment for breast cancer.

items.title: Legislative Priorities and State Budget
items.summary: Mossalam outlines her policy priorities, focusing on state budget fiscal responsibility, public transit, school funding, and community infrastructure.

items.title: Voter Outreach and Campaign Events
items.summary: Mossalam emphasizes the importance of the September 3 Democratic primary, provides contact details for her campaign, and announces an April 21 kickoff event.
